thread.title_full: Scott Jennings on California Governor Race and One-Party Rule: 'Democrats Are Running the State and the State Kind of Sucks' (VIDEO) * The Gateway Pundit * by Mike LaChance

author: Bryan Mason
text:
That's why we need to go back to the Federalist No. 45 and Federalist No. 46, both written by James Madison in giving the ultimate power to the states. That way you can at least have states with their own governing laws and policies and the most successful states will be obvious. This was always how the country was intended to be from the very beginning.
The Supremacy Clause is the biggest mistake in the U.S. Constitution and basically makes the states servants to this massive, corrupt federal gov't we have. The only correction would be a Convention of States, but it's doubtful we could ever get 34 states to call for one.
